verdict.rationale: The only native background automation in evidence is scheduled automated full exports. The built-in AI proposes creates and updates for the user to approve rather than acting on its own, and property auto-fill is user-invoked. Truly autonomous automations would require building an external agent or bot against the REST API or MCP. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/workflow engine (triggers, actions, schedules beyond export), autonomous AI agents running without approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
